born.why: The code improves survival by using trait-overlap inference to avoid poisonous fruits without tasting them, reducing unnecessary health loss while maintaining curiosity for safe unknowns.

The code prioritizes survival by treating unknown fruits as potentially lethal unless tasted safely, uses a dynamic pantry threshold to avoid hoarding useless items, and ensures Fagi only seeks new information when her hunger level is low enough to withstand the risk of poisoning.

This code prioritizes survival by eating immediately only at extreme starvation (>98) or known good fruit safety, uses tasting for unknown fruits to identify poison without significant harm, and carries known good items to the pantry to reduce future foraging effort while avoiding hoarding specific species.

This code improves safety by refusing to approach unknown fruits if hunger is high enough that a poisonous bite could be fatal, and it prioritizes carrying known-good fruits to the pantry for efficient storage while eating them only when the pantry is full or starvation is imminent.

The code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between known safe, known dangerous, and unknown fruits, using tasting to update the diary while carrying known good fruits for efficiency, and avoiding starvation-driven errors by keeping a strict hunger threshold for eating unknown items.

This code prioritizes survival by eating only when hunger is critically high (>90-98%), otherwise tasting unknown fruits to learn their safety or carrying known good ones to the pantry, while avoiding known poisonous species and ensuring she doesn't carry food if already burdened.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when critically starving, uses tasting to safely learn new species, and carries known safe fruits to the pantry for future efficiency while avoiding known toxins.
